scope: Classification of the ICU/CTICU care/equipment additions and labeling of the 18 procedure pairs and 42 ICU topics

categories.guideline: Direct recommendation or definition; retain strength, source year and population
categories.consensus: Consensus guidance; do not invent a GRADE strength or call it an international standard
categories.knowledge: General clinical or equipment knowledge supported by the source; not a treatment protocol
categories.practice: Context-dependent clinical practice or authored application; individual choices vary
categories.synthetic: Fictional patients, values and original decision trees; not observed outcomes or standardized regimens

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Self-report/behavioral pain assessment
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Reliable self-report; behavioral assessment when self-report is unavailable and behaviors can be observed.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Pain assessment and treatment before sedation
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Pain and sedation remain separate assessments.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Assessment-driven stepwise pain/sedation approach
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Approach is recommended; the fictional regimen is not prescribed by the guideline.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Acetaminophen adjunct
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Adjunct to opioid therapy in critically ill adults.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Postoperative ketamine adjunct
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Selected postsurgical ICU adults when reducing opioid consumption.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Neuropathic agent with opioids for neuropathic pain
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Neuropathic pain indication, not every acute postoperative pain.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Against routine IV lidocaine adjunct
verified_recommendation_groups.classification: Guideline recommendation — conditional against routine use
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: ICU opioid-adjunct context; not a blanket statement about all lidocaine indications.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Dexmedetomidine over propofol in the defined priority setting
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Mechanically ventilated ICU adults when light sedation and/or delirium reduction are highest priorities.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Induction hypnotic when NMBA is used
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Critically ill adult intubation; paralysis does not establish unconsciousness.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: NMBA with sedative-hypnotic induction
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: The guideline RSI population; not a standalone drug-choice recipe.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Specific preoxygenation strategies
verified_recommendation_groups.source_location: Preoxygenation and Med-Assisted Preoxygenation; low/very low certainty
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Different suggestions for anticipated difficult laryngoscopy, severe hypoxemia or inability to tolerate oxygenation interfaces.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Waveform CO2 and exclusion of esophageal tube placement
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: PUMA explicitly describes consensus guidance, not international standards; do not assign a GRADE strength here.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Plateau pressure, tidal volume, PEEP/auto-PEEP assessment
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Assessment recommendations, not a universal ventilator prescription.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: FiO2, humidification and airway securement assessment
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Recommendation strength differs from plateau-pressure/tidal-volume assessment.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: HFNC over conventional oxygen in acute hypoxemic failure
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Adults with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure; not every ICU condition.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Bilevel NIV for COPD-related respiratory acidosis
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Acute or acute-on-chronic respiratory acidosis due to COPD exacerbation; assess suitability and deterioration.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: CPAP or bilevel NIV for cardiogenic pulmonary edema
verified_recommendation_groups.source_location: Cardiogenic pulmonary edema recommendation; moderate certainty
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Do not extrapolate directly to cardiogenic shock or acute coronary syndromes excluded from the supporting population.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: SBT with or without pressure support; RSBI not required for readiness
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Adult ventilator liberation; the exact case remains an application.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Standardized assessment for an appropriate daily SBT
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Standardizing the assessment process is different from a fixed extubation time.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Preventive NIV immediately after planned extubation
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: High extubation-failure risk, ventilated more than 24 hours and passed an SBT; patient-specific suitability still matters.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Higher PEEP without recruitment maneuvers
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: ATS: moderate-to-severe ARDS. Other societies differ; not a universal PEEP strategy.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Against prolonged recruitment maneuvers
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Moderate-to-severe ARDS; separate from the higher-PEEP recommendation.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Blood cultures in possible/probable/definite sepsis
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Adults with sepsis/septic shock; obtain promptly, ideally before antimicrobials without harmful delay.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Blood lactate in suspected sepsis
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Interpret with clinical context, not as a complete diagnosis or automatic fluid instruction.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: Creatinine/urine-output AKI definition
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: The 2012 KDIGO definition supports the fictional creatinine arithmetic; it does not diagnose etiology.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: RRT decision from context and trends
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Clinical needs and trajectory rather than one creatinine/BUN number.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

verified_recommendation_groups.claim: CRRT rather than standard intermittent RRT in instability
verified_recommendation_groups.scope: Hemodynamically unstable AKI patients requiring RRT; historical 2012 guidance, not universal modality superiority.
verified_recommendation_groups.result: Supported within the stated source population and qualification

lab_examples.title: Postoperative bleeding and anemia
lab_examples.classification: General clinical knowledge and context-dependent bleeding assessment; the fictional hemoglobin change is not a standardized transfusion trigger.

lab_examples.title: Carbon dioxide retention and acidemia
lab_examples.classification: General clinical knowledge plus synthetic numerical interpretation; this is not a guideline-defined intubation or ventilator-adjustment threshold.

lab_examples.title: Oxygenation under defined support
lab_examples.classification: General clinical knowledge/arithmetic; the P:F calculation is not a complete diagnostic criterion or treatment instruction.

lab_examples.title: Lactate in sepsis or postoperative shock
lab_examples.classification: Guideline recommendation G24 is conditional (low certainty) for measuring lactate in sepsis; interpretation and response in this case are context-dependent.

lab_examples.title: Kidney injury after major surgery
lab_examples.classification: Guideline diagnostic definition G25 is not graded. The fictional creatinine change fits a definition component after context checks; the cause and management remain clinical assessments.

lab_examples.title: Potassium and rhythm/perfusion changes
lab_examples.classification: General clinical knowledge and context-dependent urgent assessment. The fictional potassium value is not asserted to be one universal treatment threshold.

lab_examples.title: New fever and a suspected source
lab_examples.classification: Guideline recommendation G23 is strong (low certainty) for blood cultures in the stated sepsis population. Other source-directed investigations remain context-dependent; general fever guidance excludes severe immunocompromise.

lab_examples.title: Bleeding/thrombosis balance with anticoagulation
lab_examples.classification: General clinical knowledge and drug/device-specific practice; there is no universal assay or target across these therapies.

lab_examples.title: Anemia or dark urine during mechanical support
lab_examples.classification: General clinical knowledge and specialist practice; no isolated marker establishes pump thrombosis.

lab_examples.title: Fluid, electrolyte and acid-base needs during CRRT
lab_examples.classification: Guideline statements G26 are not graded; CRRT preference in unstable patients (G27) is conditional, 2B. Monitoring and adjustment remain individualized.

lab_examples.title: A displayed number that conflicts with the patient
lab_examples.classification: General measurement knowledge and official device-safety information, applied to fictional observations.

equipment.title: ICU ventilator
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge; patient-ventilator assessment recommendations G13–G14 have distinct strong/conditional grades.

equipment.title: Anesthesia workstation
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge from a clinical review; not a single standardized workstation configuration or operating sequence.

equipment.title: HFNC system
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge; the selected clinical indication G15 has conditional guideline support.

equipment.title: Noninvasive positive-pressure system
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge; G16/G17 are strong recommendations in specific disease populations, not universal NIV use.

equipment.title: Airway devices and visualization equipment
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge and context-dependent airway planning; specific RSI statements G09–G11 and confirmation guidance G12 are separate.

equipment.title: Waveform capnograph
equipment.classification: Consensus guidance G12 supports airway-confirmation use; the source does not claim international standards.

equipment.title: Pulse oximeter
equipment.classification: General measurement knowledge and official FDA safety information; not a treatment protocol.

equipment.title: Arterial catheter/transducer
equipment.classification: General clinical/measurement knowledge; selection and interpretation depend on the clinical setting.

equipment.title: Central venous catheter
equipment.classification: General clinical/measurement knowledge; selection and interpretation depend on the clinical setting.

equipment.title: Pulmonary artery catheter
equipment.classification: General clinical/measurement knowledge and selected specialist practice; not routine use for every ICU patient.

equipment.title: Infusion or syringe pump
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge and official FDA risk-reduction guidance; device safeguards do not establish a clinical regimen.

equipment.title: Pleural chest-drain system
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge and procedure-specific practice; pleural guidance is not a standardized cardiac mediastinal-drain protocol.

equipment.title: Temporary epicardial pacing system
equipment.classification: General clinical/equipment knowledge and context-dependent specialist practice; the cited review explicitly rejects one correct pacing approach for every postoperative patient.

equipment.title: CRRT machine and circuit
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge; G27 is a conditional 2B modality recommendation for the stated unstable AKI population.

equipment.title: VV-ECMO circuit
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge and specialist selection; describing the circuit does not recommend it for every severe respiratory case.

equipment.title: VA-ECMO circuit
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge and specialist selection; not a standardized response to any one pressure or lactate.

equipment.title: Intra-aortic balloon pump
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge and selected specialist practice; no universal survival-benefit or routine-use claim is made.

equipment.title: Durable LVAD
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge and specialist practice; a controller display is not a standardized management rule.

equipment.title: Temporary left-sided microaxial pump
equipment.classification: General equipment knowledge and selected specialist practice; no universal device-selection or adjustment protocol is implied.

corrections.change: Separate the ATS conditional recommendation for higher PEEP without recruitment maneuvers from its strong recommendation against prolonged recruitment maneuvers.
State the COPD-acidosis and cardiogenic-pulmonary-edema populations; do not extend the latter recommendation directly to shock/ACS.
State high risk, more than 24 hours ventilation and passed SBT, rather than an unspecified guideline population.

review_method: Compared the scoped statements with public source recommendation sections, definitions and clinical/equipment passages. Recorded source locations and source strength where directly stated; technical function descriptions remain general knowledge and case selections remain context-dependent practice.
